$comment: Committed action pin record (issue #219 AC1). Every third-party `uses:` line in .github/workflows/*.yml must pin one of these action@sha pairs and carry a version comment whose label is in that pair's versions list (labels in use across the repo; the SHA is the binding, labels are human aliases). Validated offline by desktop/src/__tests__/acceptance-precision-contract.test.ts -t pin-comments. Adding a new pinned action requires a record entry here; changing a pin requires updating the entry's sha and versions together.
